name: dungeon-sovereign
description: Dungeon Sovereign v7.0: 2.5D Overhaul, Lockstep Unity & Synergies

scripts.test: node replay/checks.js && node replay/lockstep.js && node replay/parity.js
scripts.apk:sync: mkdir -p android/app/src/main/assets/public/shared && cp index.html game.html bridge.js controls.js net.js worker-parity.js android/app/src/main/assets/public/ && cp shared/sim-core.js android/app/src/main/assets/public/shared/ && touch android/app/src/main/assets/public/cordova.js android/app/src/main/assets/public/cordova_plugins.js
scripts.apk:debug: npm run apk:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../dist-apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../dist-apk/dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-debug.apk
scripts.apk:release: npm run apk:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../dist-apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../dist-apk/dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-release.apk
scripts.apk:bundle: npm run apk:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../dist-apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../dist-apk/dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-release.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../dist-apk/dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-debug.apk && cd ../dist-apk && sha256sum dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-release.apk dungeon-sovereign-v7.0.0-debug.apk > SHA256SUMS.txt

author: Brodie Villeneuve <brodievilleneuve@gmail.com>
